feedback:
Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. The candidate is the iteration 6 design (best raced score, 54.14: base_speed 1.25, kp 1.5, kd 0.15, ki 0, last_direction, sensors at x = +/-0.03 and +/-0.015 with 16 mm footprints) with one change: sensor y moves from 0.03 to 0.06. The geometry is valid, since y = 0.06 is inside the allowed 0.08 maximum. The change is a single variable, and it is the one geometry variable not yet tested. Iterations 1 to 9 all went off track on all 60 trials with one line loss each and max_error of about 0.060 to 0.065 m. Gains (iterations 3, 4, 7), speed (6), footprint (8), spacing (2, 9) and recovery direction (5) have each left that excursion essentially unchanged, so the remaining levers are body or drivetrain variables and forward sensor placement. Your lag argument is plausible for bends, but the excursion starts from a steady offset, so the benefit is uncertain. Racing is more informative than another revision round, and one iteration remains after this one to exploit the result.

What to do next, depending on the race telemetry. (a) If max_error falls below about 0.060 m or line_loss_events drops on some seeds, keep y = 0.06 and check progress, completion_time and steering_oscillation before adding anything else. Consider y = 0.08 as the next step only if the trend is clear. (b) If max_error, line_loss_events and progress are unchanged, forward placement is not the limit. Restore y = 0.03 and test wheel_track = 0.10 with the iteration 6 controller, since a higher yaw rate per PWM difference may correct the drift. (c) If steering_oscillation rises sharply with no gain in max_error, return y to 0.03, because the longer lever is adding jitter without reducing the excursion.
requested_changes: Keep sensor y = 0.06 and all other iteration 6 values. Judge the result on max_error and line_loss_events against the iteration 6 values (about 0.0606, 0.0653, 0.0657 m, one loss per trial), and on progress against 0.11 to 0.165.

If max_error and line_loss_events are unchanged, set sensor y back to 0.03 and test geometry.wheel_track = 0.10 as a single change, since the sensor and gain levers have shown no effect on the excursion.
If steering_oscillation rises sharply with no gain in max_error, set sensor y back to 0.03 so the controller returns to the iteration 6 values.
